context: Kenji proposes a new system architecture to Hiroshi.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 部長、新しい構造、提案です。
lines.en: Boss, I have a proposal for a new structural approach.
lines.style: Open with quiet resolve. Warm, professional tone—not deferential, but genuinely respectful. Pace steady and even. Let each phrase land clearly without rushing. The careful cadence of someone bringing a real idea to someone who will actually listen.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: I'm listening. Give me the essentials.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly with the opening. Tone direct but not cold—the readiness of someone experienced enough to recognize when an idea is worth hearing. Firm, measured pace. No warmth wasted, but no harshness either.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 機能、再構築。効果、上がる、見込み。
lines.en: We'd rebuild the functional framework. The projected outcome is improved efficiency across the board.
lines.style: Clearer now, more confident. Lean into the concrete details. Warm undertone—this is something he believes in. Pace picks up slightly with conviction. Let the specificity show he's thought this through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: リスク、ある。慎重に、考えろ。
lines.en: There will be risks involved. You need to think through them carefully.
lines.style: Not a warning, but a weight placed. Tone stays composed but the seriousness settles in. Slower pace here—each word deliberate. The quiet authority of someone who's seen proposals fail. Not discouraging, just honest.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I'll conduct a thorough analysis with complete rigor.
lines.style: Steady commitment in the voice. Warm again—he's listening to the caution and responding seriously. Pace controlled. The tone says: I hear you, and I'll do this right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: チームと、一緒に、進めろ。
lines.en: Work through this with your team. Move forward together.
lines.style: Brief, clear instruction with an undertone of trust. Tone steady. The implication is that he believes Kenji capable of leading this. No micromanagement—just the standard of care he expects.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Yes, understood. I appreciate your confidence.
lines.style: Respectful close. Warm gratitude beneath the formality. Pace settles. The genuine relief and respect of someone who's been given real responsibility by someone who matters.
